Maya Li: quick q — customer A asked for split-routing their traffic to our optimized quantized model. Do we deprioritize this (low RICE) or run a small split test + canary? :thinking_face:
Carl O'Neil: what's the ask exactly? is this about latency improvement or cost reduction? those change R/I/E numbers a lot.
Maya Li: mostly cost and slightly better tail latency for their 2k seq use case. They want a traffic-sliced experiment to measure quality delta too.
Alexa Gupta: personally i'd avoid a full prod flip without guardrails. proposal: internal canary on staging -> 0.5% customer facing canary -> 3% A/B for 48h -> ramp if metrics ok. automatic fallback to baseline model on regressions.
Alexa Gupta: rollout config (sketch):
```yaml
canary: 0.005
ab_test: 0.03
duration_hours: 48
rollback_conditions:
  - p95_latency_increase_pct > 10
  - error_rate_increase_absolute > 0.5
  - quality_delta_negative_more_than 0.02
```
Maya Li: what exactly should we measure for "quality_delta"? embedding sim? human eval?
Alexa Gupta: start with automated heuristics: embedding cosine vs baseline on core prompt set + top-k token overlap for generation features. flag for manual review if automated score drops > 0.015. also track customer business metrics if they can provide them.
Samir Patel: infra note — the quantized variant needs a different runtime. if we put canary on hosted fleet we might not have capacity without reserving a small dedicated pool. otherwise we'll throttle and skew results. cost for a 3% slice for 48h ~ estimate $1.2k.
Carl O'Neil: tradeoff: deprioritize and save engineering cycles vs run lightweight split test to validate whether savings are real. If impact (savings) is uncertain, a small canary buys evidence for RICE calculation.
Maya Li: ok decision suggestion: run internal canary tomorrow, then 1% customer A/B for 24h (shorter than Alexa suggested) to get signal, then decide ramp. rollback auto if any of these triggers. owners: Alexa = rollout config + metrics, Samir = infra pool, Carl = decision owner if results ambiguous, I'll communicate to customer.
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary job created by @Alexa Gupta — canary window 2026-06-10T14:00Z -> 2026-06-10T16:00Z (internal).
Alexa Gupta: sounds good. i'll add the canary checklist to the runbook and put the threshold alerts into the dashboard. tagging owners in the checklist. :white_check_mark:
Maya Li: thanks all — i'll inform customer about the plan and set expectations.
Carl O'Neil: if results show >10% cost reduction and <1% quality delta we push to larger ab. otherwise deprioritize. simple RICE re-eval afterwards.
Alexa Gupta: I'll also add a fail-open fallback to route to baseline model on any SDK errors so customers don't see 5xx.
Maya Li: perfect, closing thread — will post results here after canary. :wave:
